text:
Situation: Methylprednisolone acetate injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-12-15 for Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Eugia US LLC, Par Health USA LLC, Pfizer Inc., and Sagent Pharmaceuticals. As of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been listed for 58 months. Corvale East holds 16 vials of the 20 mg/mL 5 mL presentation (NDC 0009-0274-01) at 6 vials per day, providing 2.7 days on hand. Corvale General holds 158 vials at 6.9 per day, providing 22.8 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows Current status first posted 2021-12-15 for the five manufacturers above. The 20 mg/mL 5 mL vial used at Corvale East and Corvale General is labeled by Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189). FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI; the classification letter was issued 2024-09-10, 548 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: Corvale East is critically low on the 20 mg/mL 5 mL vial. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer while maintaining two weeks of supply. Other presentations and sites have adequate inventory for current use.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 61 vials of 20 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 5 vials of 40 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Transfer 12 tablets of 4 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
4. Transfer 8 tablets of 4 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of transfer request.

Not recommended: Purchase from Caplin Steriles Limited; the product is not on FDA's shortage list and its label does not identify a manufacturing plant we can verify.
